title: GUNFIRE AND RINGS LIGHT IN COLOUR
why: His order of 2026-10-12 on the graphics program: add all of it, gritty and grounded like ARC Raiders. The lights that come and go (gunfire, blasts, a machine hunting you, the beacon) cut grey holes in the dark. At LIGHTING HIGH and STANDARD they now light the ground in their own colour: muzzle flashes amber, blasts orange, a hunting machine you can see in the red of its eyes, and the beacon and every open extraction ring in teal, with a soft teal pool over each open ring so you can find it at night. Nothing about sight, sound or stealth changes, and CLASSIC is the old look.
now: Gunfire, blasts, hunting machines and open extraction rings now light the ground in their own colour at night.
